scheme.note: Each correct answer +1.0; each incorrect answer -0.25.

sets.title: CEE Hard-Focused Practice Set 1
sets.description: 200 questions, Hard-weighted, with consistent negative marking.

questions.text: A patient with mania is best managed with:

options.label: A
options.text: A calm environment and antimanic medication

questions.correctText: A calm environment and antimanic medication
questions.rationale: Low stimulation aids stability.

questions.text: A medication error occurs; the priority is:
questions.rationale: Patient safety comes first, then reporting.

questions.text: If a person’s diet lacks iodine, which gland is most affected?
questions.rationale: Iodine is required for thyroid hormone synthesis.

questions.text: If A=1, B=2, … then DOG encodes as:
A newborn with meconium-stained amniotic fluid and absent breath sounds likely has:
questions.rationale: Aspirated meconium causes meconium aspiration syndrome.

questions.text: If a population of bacteria is exposed to an antibiotic, resistant survivors indicate:

options.label: B
options.text: New mutations caused by the drug

questions.rationale: Resistance pre-exists; antibiotics select survivors.

questions.text: If mosquito breeding sites are eliminated, the impact on malaria is:
questions.rationale: Removing breeding sites reduces vector populations.

questions.text: If gibberellin is applied to a dwarf pea plant, the expected result is:
questions.rationale: Gibberellin promotes stem elongation.

questions.text: What is 20% of 150?
A first-order reaction is 75% complete in 40 min; its half-life is:
questions.rationale: 75% complete = 2 half-lives; 40/2 = 20 min.

questions.text: In a pedigree where an affected male has all daughters affected but no sons affected, the most likely mode of inheritance is:
questions.rationale: X-linked dominant traits pass from affected father to all daughters.

questions.text: Which is a priority nursing intervention for a patient with acute psychosis?
questions.rationale: Safety and antipsychotics are priority for acute psychosis.

questions.text: Which is the priority for a patient with a fractured femur?
questions.rationale: Immobilization prevents further injury.

questions.text: To reduce neonatal mortality, the most cost-effective intervention is:
questions.rationale: Skilled attendance prevents birth complications.

questions.text: A galvanic cell with Zn/Zn2+ and Cu/Cu2+ has a positive E° because:

options.label: A
options.text: Cu2+ has higher reduction potential than Zn2+

questions.correctText: Cu2+ has higher reduction potential than Zn2+
questions.rationale: Cu2+ is more easily reduced, driving the cell.

questions.text: Electrolysis of aqueous NaCl produces which gas at the cathode?
questions.rationale: Water is reduced to H2 at the cathode in aqueous brine.

questions.text: Resonance in a series RLC circuit occurs when:

options.label: A
options.text: Inductive and capacitive reactance are equal

questions.correctText: Inductive and capacitive reactance are equal
questions.rationale: At resonance XL = XC.

questions.text: The length and breadth of a rectangle are increased by 15% and 25% respectively. What is the percentage increase in area?
If the stomata of a leaf are blocked by vaseline, which is most likely?
questions.rationale: Blocked stomata limit CO2 entry and water loss.

questions.text: A seizure in a febrile child is managed by:
questions.rationale: Protect from injury; do not restrain.

questions.text: A depressed patient with a plan to self-harm needs:
questions.rationale: Suicidal risk needs observation.

questions.text: What is the total resistance of two 6 Ω resistors connected in parallel?
Which is the recommended position for a newborn immediately after birth?
questions.rationale: Skin-to-skin contact promotes bonding and thermoregulation.

questions.text: The oxidation state of Cr in K2Cr2O7 is:
A patient receiving opioids for pain must be monitored for:
questions.rationale: Opioids depress respiration.

questions.text: Which forest type is found in the Terai region of Nepal?
questions.rationale: Tropical deciduous forests dominate the Terai region.

questions.text: If antenatal care coverage is low, the nurse partners with:
questions.rationale: Community health workers extend reach.

questions.text: A vaccine that uses only the capsid protein of a virus (no genetic material) is an example of:
questions.rationale: Subunit vaccines contain isolated antigens such as proteins.

questions.text: If the parasympathetic nervous system is activated, which of the following is most likely?
questions.rationale: Parasympathetic activity slows the heart.

questions.text: Antepartum hemorrhage with shock needs:
questions.rationale: Shock requires urgent care.

questions.text: A charge moving perpendicular to a magnetic field follows a:
questions.rationale: The magnetic force provides centripetal force.

questions.text: If the lymphatic vessels of a limb are surgically removed, which is most expected?
questions.rationale: Lymphatics return interstitial fluid; removal causes edema.

questions.text: Which indicator is commonly used in acid-base titration?
questions.rationale: Phenolphthalein and methyl orange are common acid-base indicators.

questions.text: A pendulum’s period increases if its:
questions.rationale: T ∝ √L.

questions.text: If the apical meristem is removed, the plant most likely shows:

options.label: A
options.text: Loss of apical dominance and lateral growth

questions.correctText: Loss of apical dominance and lateral growth
questions.rationale: Removal of apical meristem releases lateral buds.

questions.text: A reaction has Ea = 50 kJ/mol; a catalyst lowers Ea to 30 kJ/mol. The rate constant will:
questions.rationale: Lower activation energy increases the rate constant.

questions.text: If pressure is doubled for N2O4 ⇌ 2NO2, the equilibrium shifts:
questions.rationale: Higher pressure favors the side with fewer gas moles.

questions.text: Which position is most appropriate for a patient with difficulty breathing?
questions.rationale: Fowler's position eases breathing by opening the airway.

questions.text: Which is a priority nursing intervention for a suicidal patient?
questions.rationale: Safety and observation are priority for suicidal patients.

questions.text: The IUPAC name of CH3COCH3 is:
questions.rationale: A three-carbon ketone is propanone (acetone).

questions.text: Which hybrid orbitals form in methane (CH4)?
questions.rationale: Four sigma bonds require sp3 hybridization.

questions.text: A plant lacking chlorophyll in its leaves is most likely:
questions.rationale: Without chlorophyll it cannot photosynthesize.

questions.text: An alcoholic in withdrawal needs monitoring for:
questions.rationale: Withdrawal can cause DT/seizures.

questions.text: Which reagent is used to test for aldehydes?
questions.rationale: Tollens' reagent (ammoniacal silver nitrate) tests for aldehydes.

questions.text: An odds ratio of 3.0 in a study means:

options.label: A
options.text: Exposure associated with 3× the odds of outcome

questions.correctText: Exposure associated with 3× the odds of outcome
questions.rationale: OR > 1 indicates positive association.

questions.text: Saponification of an ester with NaOH yields:
questions.rationale: Base hydrolysis of fats gives soap and glycerol.

questions.text: A drug that blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in neurons would most likely:
questions.rationale: Sodium influx is required for the rising phase of the action potential.

questions.text: If the distance from a point charge doubles, the field strength:
questions.rationale: E ∝ 1/r²; doubling r makes E one-fourth.

questions.text: Which blood group is the universal donor?
questions.rationale: O negative lacks A, B and Rh antigens, so it can be given to all.

questions.text: A child with suspected intussusception presents with:

options.label: A
options.text: Intermittent colicky pain and currant-jelly stool

questions.correctText: Intermittent colicky pain and currant-jelly stool
questions.rationale: Currant-jelly stool is classic.

questions.text: Series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ? The next number is:
questions.rationale: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, 12.

questions.text: To improve hand-hygiene compliance, the manager uses:
questions.rationale: Feedback and access improve compliance.

questions.text: A 6-month infant with non-blanching purpura needs urgent exclusion of:
questions.rationale: Non-blanching rash suggests sepsis.

questions.text: A child with frequent AOM should be evaluated for:
questions.rationale: Recurrent AOM risks hearing loss.

questions.text: If a cholera outbreak hits a camp, the priority intervention is:
questions.rationale: Rehydration and clean water save lives.

questions.text: A conflict between two nurses is best resolved by:
questions.rationale: Mediation addresses root causes.

questions.text: A neonate with jaundice at 24 hours needs:
questions.rationale: Early jaundice may be pathological.

questions.text: A client with heart failure and a 2 kg weight gain in 2 days needs:
questions.rationale: Rapid weight gain signals fluid retention.

questions.text: What is 15% of 200?
A patient with stroke and dysphagia should be assessed for:
questions.rationale: Dysphagia raises aspiration risk.

questions.text: Work done by a 10 N force moving 5 m in its direction is:
What is the pH of a 0.001 M HCl solution?
If all A are B, all B are C, and some C are D, which MUST be true?
questions.rationale: Transitivity gives A ⊂ B ⊂ C.

questions.text: A breastfed baby not gaining weight needs assessment of:
questions.rationale: Feeding technique affects intake.

questions.text: A patient with systolic BP 80 and confusion needs:
questions.rationale: Hypotension with confusion signals shock.

questions.text: A solution conducts electricity only weakly; it is likely:
questions.rationale: Weak electrolytes partially ionize.

questions.text: If a population is exposed to a new predator that selectively catches the slowest individuals, the most expected evolutionary outcome over generations is:

options.label: A
options.text: Increased average speed due to natural selection

questions.correctText: Increased average speed due to natural selection
questions.rationale: Selection against slow individuals raises average speed.

questions.text: To verify nasogastric tube placement before feeding, the nurse uses:
questions.rationale: Aspirate pH confirms position.

questions.text: Which wetland site in Nepal is designated as a Ramsar site?
questions.rationale: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve is a Ramsar site in Nepal.

questions.text: A lens of focal length 10 cm forms an image at 30 cm; the object distance is:
A patient on warfarin with melena: the nurse anticipates:

options.label: A
options.text: Hold the dose and give vitamin K

questions.correctText: Hold the dose and give vitamin K
questions.rationale: Bleeding on warfarin needs reversal.

questions.text: Damage to the cerebellum would most impair:
questions.rationale: The cerebellum coordinates movement and balance.

questions.text: An object in free fall for 2 s reaches speed (g = 10):
If 22.4 L of a gas at STP weighs 32 g, its molar mass is:
questions.rationale: At STP 22.4 L = 1 mol, so molar mass = 32 g/mol.

questions.text: Which compound is used as a fertilizer to supply nitrogen to plants?
questions.rationale: Urea (CO(NH2)2) is a nitrogen-rich fertilizer.

questions.text: What is the momentum of a 2 kg object moving at 3 m/s?
questions.rationale: Momentum p = mv = 2 × 3 = 6 kg·m/s.

questions.text: In a typical anther, microspore mother cells undergo which division to form pollen?
questions.rationale: Meiosis produces haploid microspores (pollen).

questions.text: A mutation disabling the gene for phytochrome would most affect:
questions.rationale: Phytochrome mediates light-dependent photoperiod responses.

questions.text: A seed requiring cold treatment (vernalization) before germination is an adaptation to:
questions.rationale: Vernalization ensures germination occurs after winter.

questions.text: Documentation after a fall should include:
questions.rationale: Complete documentation supports care.

questions.text: If a square is rotated 45°, its outline most resembles a:
questions.rationale: A rotated square becomes diamond-shaped.

questions.text: A buffer resists pH change because it contains:

options.label: A
options.text: A weak acid and its conjugate base

questions.correctText: A weak acid and its conjugate base
questions.rationale: Conjugate pairs neutralize added acid/base.

questions.text: A malnourished child’s feeding should be:
questions.rationale: Frequent nutrient-dense feeds aid recovery.

questions.text: The major product of Markovnikov hydration of propene is:
questions.rationale: H and OH add so OH attaches to the more substituted carbon.

questions.text: A ball thrown upward reaches maximum height when:
questions.rationale: At the top, instantaneous velocity is zero.

questions.text: A case-control study is best for investigating:
questions.rationale: Case-control efficiently studies rare outcomes.

questions.text: In a mass-casualty disaster, triage prioritizes:
questions.rationale: Triage saves the most lives.

questions.text: In a DNA molecule, if 30% of the bases are adenine, the percentage of cytosine is:
If soil pH is highly acidic, which nutrient becomes less available?
questions.rationale: Acidity precipitates phosphorus, reducing availability.

questions.text: A sound wave of 1000 Hz in air (340 m/s) has wavelength:
A 5 F capacitor at 10 V stores energy:
A 5-year-old with wheeze and atopy is managed with:
questions.rationale: Asthma needs bronchodilators/steroids.

questions.text: In C4 plants, the initial CO2 fixation product is:
questions.rationale: PEP carboxylase forms oxaloacetate in C4 plants.

questions.text: Pollen from a genetically modified plant escaping to a wild relative is most concerning for:
questions.rationale: Transgene escape alters wild populations.

questions.text: If a country’s infant mortality rate rises, the most likely contributor is:
questions.rationale: Limited neonatal care raises infant deaths.

questions.text: If a shirt costs Rs. 500 and is discounted 20%, what is the sale price?
A child with severe pneumonia and central cyanosis needs:
questions.rationale: Cyanosis indicates hypoxia.

questions.text: During DNA methylation of a promoter, gene expression generally:
questions.rationale: Methylated promoters recruit repressive complexes.

questions.text: A postpartum woman with fever and foul lochia needs:
questions.rationale: Foul lochia with fever suggests infection.

questions.text: If the day after tomorrow is Thursday, what day was yesterday?
questions.rationale: Today is Tuesday, so yesterday was Monday.

questions.text: Which of the following is a modifiable risk factor for non-communicable diseases?
questions.rationale: Tobacco use is a modifiable risk factor.

questions.text: Which type of epithelium is best suited for diffusion and filtration?
questions.rationale: Simple squamous epithelium is thin, ideal for diffusion and filtration.

questions.text: Which organelle is involved in the synthesis and packaging of proteins and lipids?
questions.rationale: The Golgi body modifies, sorts and packages proteins and lipids.

questions.text: Which structure of Spirogyra is used for sexual reproduction?
questions.rationale: Spirogyra reproduces sexually by conjugation through a conjugation tube.

questions.text: Which disease is most commonly associated with poor sanitation?
questions.rationale: Poor sanitation is linked to diarrheal diseases.

questions.text: Which measure counts existing cases at a point in time?
questions.rationale: Prevalence is a point prevalence count.

questions.text: Which hormone initiates labor contractions?
questions.rationale: Oxytocin drives labor.

questions.text: Which law relates to the entropy of an isolated system?
questions.rationale: The second law states entropy of an isolated system increases.

questions.text: Which phenomenon is caused by the depletion of the ozone layer?
questions.rationale: Ozone depletion allows more harmful UV radiation to reach Earth.

questions.text: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?
questions.rationale: The pulmonary vein is the only vein carrying oxygenated blood.

questions.text: Which leadership style makes all decisions?
questions.rationale: Autocratic leaders decide alone.

questions.text: Which is a sign of internal bleeding?
questions.rationale: Hypotension and tachycardia indicate internal bleeding.

questions.text: Which level of disease prevention aims to halt the progression of disease at an early stage?
questions.rationale: Secondary prevention detects and treats disease early.

questions.text: A pregnant woman should ideally begin antenatal visits:

options.label: A
options.text: As early as possible in pregnancy

questions.correctText: As early as possible in pregnancy
questions.rationale: Early antenatal contact improves outcomes.

questions.text: Which is a sign of severe acute malnutrition in a child?
questions.rationale: Severe wasting indicates severe acute malnutrition.

questions.text: In the life cycle of Plasmodium, which stage is infective to humans?
questions.rationale: Sporozoites injected by mosquito bite are infective to humans.

questions.text: Which position is recommended to offload a sacral pressure injury?
questions.rationale: Side-lying relieves sacral pressure.

questions.text: Which quantity is a scalar?
questions.rationale: Speed has magnitude only.

questions.text: What is the normal fetal heart rate?
questions.rationale: Normal FHR is 110–160.

questions.text: Which gas is produced when zinc reacts with dilute HCl?
questions.rationale: Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl2 + H2.

questions.text: Which type of reaction is esterification?
questions.rationale: Esterification is a condensation reaction between an acid and alcohol.

questions.text: What is the relationship between Kp and Kc for a gaseous reaction?
questions.rationale: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn where Δn is the change in moles of gas.

questions.text: Which type of vaccine uses a weakened form of the pathogen?
questions.rationale: Live attenuated vaccines use weakened live pathogens.

questions.text: Which indicator best reflects a country’s child health status?
questions.rationale: U5MR summarizes child survival.

questions.text: Which type of endosperm is formed by the fusion of one sperm with two polar nuclei?
questions.rationale: Double fertilization produces triploid (3n) endosperm.

questions.text: Which mineral is a component of chlorophyll?
questions.rationale: Magnesium is at the center of the chlorophyll molecule.

questions.text: What is the correct angle for an intramuscular injection?
questions.rationale: IM injections use 90°.

questions.text: Which word does not belong to the group?
questions.rationale: Mango is a fruit; the others are flowers.

questions.text: What is the first step of the nursing process?
questions.rationale: Assessment comes first.

questions.text: Which plant hormone is associated with stress responses like drought?
questions.rationale: ABA mediates drought stress responses.

questions.text: Lamarck's theory of evolution is based primarily on:
questions.rationale: Lamarckism emphasizes inheritance of acquired characteristics.

questions.text: Which part of the seed develops into the shoot?
questions.rationale: The plumule forms the shoot.

questions.text: Which structure in the frog is used for respiration on land?
questions.rationale: Adult frogs respire through lungs and skin on land.

questions.text: Which phenomenon explains the formation of a rainbow?
questions.rationale: Dispersion splits white light into colors.

questions.text: Which process transports sugars from leaves to roots?
questions.rationale: Phloem translocates sugars.

questions.text: What is the normal adult body temperature?
questions.rationale: Normal is about 37°C.

questions.text: Which is a modifiable risk factor for disease?
questions.rationale: Smoking can be changed.

questions.text: Which class of vertebrates has a three-chambered heart?
questions.rationale: Amphibians have a three-chambered heart (two atria, one ventricle).

questions.text: Which is a sign of malnutrition in a child?
questions.rationale: Weight loss indicates malnutrition.

questions.text: Which device is used to measure electric current?
questions.rationale: An ammeter measures electric current.

questions.text: How many vertices does a cube have?
questions.rationale: A cube has 8 vertices (corners).

questions.text: Which tissue provides mechanical support and is composed of dead cells?
questions.rationale: Sclerenchyma consists of dead cells providing mechanical support.

questions.text: Which disorder is characterized by persistent sadness and loss of interest?
questions.rationale: Major depressive disorder involves persistent sadness and anhedonia.

questions.text: Which is a sign of dehydration in an adult?
questions.rationale: Decreased urine output indicates dehydration.

questions.text: Which functional group is present in carboxylic acids?
questions.rationale: Carboxylic acids contain the carboxyl group (-COOH).

questions.text: Which respiratory pigment is present in the blood of an earthworm?
questions.rationale: Earthworm blood contains dissolved hemoglobin.

questions.text: Which organism causes urinary tract infections most commonly?
questions.rationale: E. coli is the most common cause of UTIs.

questions.text: Which is a common sign of dehydration in a child with diarrhea?
questions.rationale: Sunken eyes are a sign of dehydration in children.

questions.text: Which is a key component of primary health care?
questions.rationale: Health education is a key component of primary health care.

questions.text: Which of the following is a safe method of water treatment at household level?
questions.rationale: Boiling is a safe household water treatment method.

questions.text: Which is a common symptom of menopause?
questions.rationale: Hot flashes are a common menopausal symptom.

questions.text: Which is the recommended position for a woman in the second stage of labor?
questions.rationale: Upright positions aid the second stage of labor.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux?
questions.rationale: Magnetic flux is measured in webers (Wb).

questions.text: Which is the normal heart rate of an adult at rest?
questions.rationale: Normal adult resting heart rate is 60-100 bpm.

questions.text: Which part of the ear is responsible for balance?
questions.rationale: Semicircular canals detect rotational movement for balance.

questions.text: Which drug is used to treat diabetes mellitus?
questions.rationale: Metformin is an oral antidiabetic drug.

questions.text: Which structure filters blood in the kidney?
questions.rationale: The glomerulus filters blood during urine formation.

questions.text: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.rationale: A cube has 6 faces.

questions.text: Which genetic disorder is caused by trisomy of chromosome 21?
questions.rationale: Down's syndrome results from trisomy 21.

questions.text: How many pairs of aortic arches (hearts) does an earthworm have?
questions.rationale: Earthworms have 5 pairs of aortic arches acting as hearts.

questions.text: Who is known as the father of genetics?
questions.rationale: Mendel established the laws of inheritance through pea plant experiments.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of power?
questions.rationale: Power is measured in watts (W).

questions.text: Which is the correct method to administer an intramuscular injection?
questions.rationale: IM injections are given at a 90-degree angle.

questions.text: Antibodies are produced by which type of cells?
questions.rationale: Plasma cells (from B lymphocytes) produce antibodies.

questions.text: Which biomolecule acts as a biological catalyst?
questions.rationale: Enzymes are proteins that catalyze biochemical reactions.

questions.text: Which technique separates components based on their differential migration on a stationary phase?
questions.rationale: Paper chromatography separates components by differential migration.

questions.text: Which is a sign of severe dehydration in a child?
questions.rationale: Lethargy indicates severe dehydration.

questions.text: Which virus causes Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS)?
questions.rationale: HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) causes AIDS.

questions.text: Which principle states that the total momentum of an isolated system is conserved?
questions.rationale: Momentum is conserved in an isolated system.

questions.text: Which is the recommended care for a newborn immediately after birth?
questions.rationale: Drying and warming the newborn is essential.

questions.text: Which is the recommended fluid for a child with mild dehydration?
questions.rationale: ORS is recommended for mild dehydration.

questions.text: Which principle states that a system at equilibrium responds to stress by shifting to counteract it?
questions.rationale: Le Chatelier's principle describes equilibrium shifts under stress.

questions.text: Which organelle is responsible for protein synthesis?
questions.rationale: Ribosomes synthesize proteins from mRNA.

questions.text: Which is a common cause of maternal death in Nepal?
questions.rationale: Postpartum hemorrhage is a leading cause of maternal death.

questions.text: Which compound is a saturated hydrocarbon?
questions.rationale: Methane has only single C-H bonds and is saturated.

questions.text: Which condition is characterized by high blood pressure and proteinuria during pregnancy?
questions.rationale: Preeclampsia involves hypertension and proteinuria in pregnancy.

questions.text: What is the main product of alcoholic fermentation by yeast?
questions.rationale: Yeast ferments sugars to produce ethanol and CO2.

questions.text: Which vitamin is given to newborns to prevent hemorrhagic disease?
questions.rationale: Vitamin K prevents hemorrhagic disease of the newborn.

questions.text: Which is the recommended method to prevent postpartum hemorrhage?

options.label: A
options.text: Active management of third stage of labor

questions.correctText: Active management of third stage of labor
questions.rationale: Active management of the third stage prevents PPH.

questions.text: Which process transfers heat through empty space?
questions.rationale: Radiation needs no medium for heat transfer.

questions.text: Which law states that force equals mass times acceleration?
questions.rationale: F = ma is Newton's second law.

questions.text: Which is the correct method to measure a patient's pulse?

options.label: B
options.text: Count for 10 seconds and multiply by 6

questions.rationale: Counting for 60 seconds is the most accurate.

questions.text: Which is the correct method to measure body temperature?
questions.rationale: Temperature can be measured orally, axillary, or rectally.

questions.text: Which hormone is primarily responsible for uterine contractions during labor?
questions.rationale: Oxytocin stimulates uterine contractions during labor.

questions.text: Which is a method of effective communication in healthcare?
questions.rationale: SBAR is an effective communication tool.

questions.text: Which is the recommended iron supplementation for pregnant women?
questions.rationale: Iron and folic acid are recommended in pregnancy.

questions.text: What is Avogadro's number?
questions.rationale: Avogadro's number is 6.022 × 10^23 particles per mole.

questions.text: Which tissue transmits nerve impulses?
questions.rationale: Nervous tissue conducts impulses via neurons.

questions.text: Which is a common cause of neonatal sepsis?
questions.rationale: Bacterial infection causes neonatal sepsis.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of frequency?
questions.rationale: Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz).

questions.text: Which vital sign is most important to monitor in a patient with hypertension?
questions.rationale: Blood pressure is the key vital sign in hypertension.

questions.text: Which structure connects muscle to bone?
questions.rationale: Tendons connect muscle to bone.

questions.text: Which of the following is a characteristic feature of mammals?
questions.rationale: Mammals are characterized by mammary glands and hair.

questions.text: Which technique separates a mixture based on differences in boiling points?
questions.rationale: Distillation separates components by boiling point differences.

questions.text: Which is the recommended treatment for a woman with eclampsia?
questions.rationale: Magnesium sulfate treats eclampsia.

questions.text: Which compound is used in bleaching powder?
questions.rationale: Bleaching powder contains calcium hypochlorite, Ca(OCl)Cl.

questions.text: Which plant group includes ferns?
questions.rationale: Ferns belong to Pteridophyta, the first vascular plants.

questions.text: Which compound is an aromatic hydrocarbon?
questions.rationale: Benzene has a stable aromatic ring.

questions.text: Which is the correct nursing action for a patient with a fever?
questions.rationale: Monitoring temperature and giving antipyretics is appropriate.

questions.text: Which vitamin is synthesized in the skin on exposure to sunlight?
questions.rationale: UV light converts 7-dehydrocholesterol to vitamin D3.

sets.title: CEE Hard-Focused Practice Set 2
sets.description: 200 questions, Hard-weighted, with consistent negative marking.

questions.text: During a sentinel event, the manager should:
questions.rationale: RCA finds system causes.

questions.text: Which type of malaria is caused by Plasmodium falciparum?
questions.rationale: P. falciparum causes malignant tertian malaria, the most severe form.

questions.text: A mother unable to latch the newborn should receive:
questions.rationale: Support improves breastfeeding.

questions.text: Continuous ECG monitoring is a priority for a patient with:
questions.rationale: Arrhythmia risk requires monitoring.

questions.text: A person with type A blood can safely receive a transfusion from which donor in an emergency?
questions.rationale: O negative is the universal donor and lacks A/B antigens.

questions.text: A mother refuses BCG for religious reasons; the nurse should:

options.label: A
options.text: Counsel respectfully and document the refusal

questions.correctText: Counsel respectfully and document the refusal
questions.rationale: Autonomy is respected with documentation.

questions.text: Which nursing intervention is priority for a patient with chest pain?
questions.rationale: Oxygen and physician notification are priority for chest pain.

questions.text: If an enzyme’s optimal pH is 7 and the solution is acidified to pH 3, activity:
questions.rationale: Extreme pH denatures the enzyme.

questions.text: A dicot root with xylem in the center has a vascular arrangement that is:
questions.rationale: Root vascular bundles are radial.

questions.text: A patient refuses a prescribed medication; the nurse should:
questions.rationale: Competent refusal is respected and recorded.

questions.text: A village has no road access; to improve immunization coverage the nurse should:
questions.rationale: Outreach reaches inaccessible populations.

questions.text: During strenuous exercise, increased CO2 production primarily stimulates breathing via:
questions.rationale: CO2 lowers CSF pH, stimulating central chemoreceptors.

questions.text: A radioactive isotope with half-life 10 years loses what fraction after 30 years?
questions.rationale: Three half-lives leave 1/8, so 7/8 is lost.

questions.text: Crossing a red-flowered (RR) with a white-flowered (rr) snapdragon gives pink (Rr), demonstrating:
questions.rationale: Heterozygotes show an intermediate phenotype.

questions.text: What is the mean of the numbers 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12?
questions.rationale: Sum = 40, divided by 5 = 8.

questions.text: A patient with acute pulmonary edema should be positioned:
questions.rationale: Upright position eases breathing.

questions.text: If a community has high open-defecation, the nurse promotes:
questions.rationale: Sanitation reduces fecal-oral disease.

questions.text: The geometry of NH3 is:
questions.rationale: Three bonds and one lone pair give trigonal pyramidal shape.

questions.text: Which type of material is used to make biodegradable plastics?
questions.rationale: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a biodegradable polymer.

questions.text: A satellite in circular orbit: if orbital radius increases, orbital speed:
All trucks are vehicles. Some vehicles are red. Therefore:
questions.rationale: Only a possibility can be concluded.

questions.text: A newborn not breathing at birth needs:
